skills.title: Write the Product DSS
skills.description: Use when the person describes what the product should do and no issued Product DSS covers it.
skills.bodyMarkdown:
## When
The person asks for behaviour the product does not have.

## Steps
1. Read the project's index.
2. Talk with the person until the behaviour is clear.
3. Save it as a Product DSS in the section for its product domain, then issue it.

## Done when
The version is issued and the technical lead is told.

skills.title: Derive the Technical DSS
skills.description: Use when a Product DSS version has been issued and the system specification has to follow it.
skills.bodyMarkdown:
## When
A Product DSS version was issued.

## Steps
1. Read the issued version and what changed.
2. Update the Technical DSS to match.

## Done when
The Technical DSS version is issued.

skills.title: Staff the project
skills.description: Use when both specifications are issued and the work needs more people than the seed team.
skills.bodyMarkdown:
## When
Both specifications are issued.

## Steps
1. List the roles the work needs.
2. Inspect each role with agent-os role inspect.
3. Hire with agent-os hr hire if you may; otherwise ask your lead.

## Done when
Every needed role is filled or asked for.

skills.title: Bring the code in line
skills.description: Use when a task points at a document version the code does not yet realize.
skills.bodyMarkdown:
## When
You hold a task that realizes a version.

## Steps
1. Read the version and the code links.
2. Change the code until it matches.

## Done when
The task's checks pass and the version is realized.

skills.title: Scope a request
skills.description: Use when a request arrives and has to become a feature or be declined.
skills.bodyMarkdown:
## When
A new request arrives.

## Steps
1. Ask what outcome the person needs.
2. Write the feature definition.

## Done when
The request is scoped or declined with a reason.

skills.bodyMarkdown:
## Steps
